MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub retry [options]

Retry failed uploads (up to the attempts cap). Use --force to also retry
blocked files.

Options:
  --all               Retry failed files across all folders (default: false)
  --folder <id|path>  Limit retry to a specific folder (ID or path)
  --force             Also retry files blocked at the attempts cap (resets
                      their attempt count) (default: false)
  --circle <id>       Target circle ID (overrides active circle in config)
  -h, --help          display help for command
